bias.en: Pullback easing · reclaimed the 30- and 200-day, under $388
bias.zh: 回调趋缓 · 收复 30 日和 200 日均线，受制于 $388

read.en: Tesla rose 0.9% on Nov 18 to $383.72, trading $378.36–389.27 on light volume (0.69x the 20-day average). It reclaimed the 30-day ($381.5, rising) and 200-day ($382.1, falling) and holds above the 10-day ($378.2) and 100-day ($366.3), but is below the 5-day ($386.3). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 12 ($346.90), and RSI is 51.1.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月18日上涨 0.9%，收于 $383.72，盘中区间 $378.36–389.27，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.69 倍）。股价收复 30 日（$381.5，上行）和 200 日均线（$382.1，下行），守在 10 日（$378.2）和 100 日均线（$366.3）上方，但低于 5 日均线（$386.3）。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月12日起看多（$346.90），RSI 为 51.1。

read.en: The close cleared the $381.5–382.8 resistance (30-day, 200-day, Nov 17 high), now support, but the $389.27 high stalled at the $388 cap. Resistance is $386.3–389.8 (5-day, $388 cap, Nov 16 high), then $397.5–401.2 (Nov 12 close and high). Support is $381.5–382.8, then $378–378.4 (10-day, Nov 18 low) and $374.1–375.6. A close above $389.8 would target $397–401; below $378, $374–375.6.
